# grace.

> Grace is a desktop Pomodoro timer with website and application blocking. This repository contains the static landing page and browser companion privacy policy.

## Visitors

- [Landing page and demo](https://grace-focus.github.io/)
- [Grace releases](https://github.com/samir-scripts/grace/releases)
- [Desktop user guide](https://github.com/samir-scripts/grace/blob/dev/docs/user-guide.md)
- [Browser companion privacy policy](https://grace-focus.github.io/privacy/)

## Contributors

- [Landing page setup and deployment](https://github.com/grace-focus/grace-focus.github.io/blob/main/README.md)
- [Desktop architecture](https://github.com/samir-scripts/grace/blob/dev/docs/architecture.md)
- [Desktop contribution guide](https://github.com/samir-scripts/grace/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md)
